title.narrative: Justice Sector Reform Programme: Governance in Justice II (GOJUST II)

description.narrative: The Justice Sector Reform Programme: Governance in Justice II (GOJUST II) gives continuity to the actions and support provided through the programme Justice Sector Reform Programme: Governance in Justice (GOJUST), and aims to strengthen the Rule of Law through a two-pronged approach by combining an improved administration of justice and enhanced promotion and protection of human rights. The programme will follow a similar implementation structure to GOJUST, with UNOPS providing support to the Justice Component (Component 1) by managing the procurement of goods and services, logistics, grant management, and communication and visibility. It will continue and expand some of the activities implemented in the previous GOJUST programme such as improved coordination between and within the justice sector agencies and case management automation interventions to strengthen capacities to decongest overburdened courts, prosecution offices, and reducing pre-trial detention. The Justice component will also focus on the Philippine Development Plan (PDP) outputs such as increased access to justice for vulnerable groups, including women, LGBTI, persons with disabilities, indigenous peoples, and other excluded groups, through a grant facility and evidence information of justice policy and practice.
